items.name: Grok Voice 3.0
items.summary: xAI's new speech-to-speech voice model launched October 14, taking over the grok-voice-latest alias (Grok Voice 2.0 is deprecated). It tops the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index at 86.9 with sub-second latency, at the same price as its predecessor.

items.name: Chainguard Harness
items.summary: Chainguard's new offering announced October 14 uses Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5.1 to hunt exploitable vulnerabilities in a live, isolated build of an organization's application, delivering verified findings with recommended fixes. A beta waitlist opened the same day, purchasable through the Claude Marketplace.

items.name: QVAC TranscribePsy
items.summary: Tether AI Research released QVAC TranscribePsy on October 14, a 254M-parameter open-source speech recognition model that runs entirely on-device rather than sending audio to cloud servers, targeting smartphones, smart glasses, and humanoid robots.

items.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
items.summary: Fish Audio released Drama 3, a text-to-speech model that takes plain-language voice direction, changes emotion partway through a sentence, generates multi-speaker scenes in a single pass, and can regenerate a selected segment of audio.

items.name: Multics (Tencent ARC Lab / HKU)
items.summary: Tencent ARC Lab and HKU open-sourced Multics under Apache 2.0 — a world model that generates first-person video of one shared scene for 4 to 10 players, with training code, inference code, and weights published.
